Old Town Scottsdale.name: Old Town Scottsdale
Old Town Scottsdale.description: Fifth Avenue and Main Street entertainment core with gallery frontage, hotel conversions, and the entertainment-district patio economy.

Arts District.name: Arts District
Arts District.description: Gallery row west of Scottsdale Road with museum adjacency, art-walk retail, and boutique office conversions.

Los Arcos Corridor.name: Los Arcos Corridor
Los Arcos Corridor.description: McDowell and Scottsdale Road retail belt with post-war strip retrofit, infill multifamily, and the Los Arcos redevelopment blocks.

SkySong District.name: SkySong District
SkySong District.description: ASU SkySong innovation campus corridor with research-office demand, student-adjacent rentals, and steady tenant-improvement permitting.

Gainey Village.name: Gainey Village
Gainey Village.description: Gainey Ranch corporate and village core with golf-community stock, Class A office along Doubletree, and stable license renewals.

Scottsdale Airpark.name: Scottsdale Airpark
Scottsdale Airpark.description: Airport and Loop 101 office corridor with aviation-adjacent industrial, WestWorld event demand, and the metro's densest corporate lease belt.

DC Ranch / Market Street.name: DC Ranch / Market Street
DC Ranch / Market Street.description: Master-planned DC Ranch village with Market Street retail, custom-lot rebuilds, and the metro's top household-income band.

Cavasson Corridor.name: Cavasson Corridor
Cavasson Corridor.description: Hayden Road corporate corridor anchored by the Cavasson master plan (Scripps/ASU campus) — evidenced by live tenant-improvement permitting at 18700 N Hayden.

Troon.name: Troon
Troon.description: Golf-community custom-home edge at the McDowell Sonoran Preserve with view-lot rebuilds and luxury remodel demand.

Desert Highlands / Happy Valley.name: Desert Highlands / Happy Valley
Desert Highlands / Happy Valley.description: Happy Valley Road gate-community belt (Desert Highlands, Troon North edges) — evidenced by live SFR-CUSTOM and NATIVE PLANT permits at 10040 E Happy Valley Rd.
